steps.text: Go down into the Edron Hero Cave.
steps.source: Go into the Edron Hero Cave (Mapper Coords 129.140, 123.150, 7).

steps.text: Follow the cave down five floors: wild warriors, demon skeletons, a beholder, monks, then dragons and a hero.
This floor is crowded (wild warriors, stalkers, hunters, priestesses, monks, demon skeletons): go down in the south-east.
Past the monks and down the next hole.
Three heroes here. The north box: the wedding ring.
steps.source: In screen 8 you will face 3 Heroes and a Dark Apprentice. Use the chests to get a Wedding Ring and a Dragon Necklace.

steps.text: The south box: a dragon necklace.
steps.source: Use the chests to get a Wedding Ring and a Dragon Necklace.
